user.title: Battery tracker
user.description: Name the tracker and select the battery percentage source.

data_description.tracker_name: Used for the Battery Consumption device and entity IDs.
data_description.source: Entity that provides the battery percentage.
data_description.attribute: Optional attribute containing the battery percentage. Leave empty to use the entity state.

mode.title: Battery configuration
mode.description: Choose whether to select a known device profile or enter battery specifications manually.

data_description.configuration_mode: Device profile fills the battery specification automatically. Manual configuration lets you enter it yourself.

profile.title: Device profile
profile.description: Detected device: {device_name}. Manufacturer: {manufacturer}. Model: {model}. Select the matching profile only when the device identity is correct; otherwise use manual configuration.

data_description.device_profile: Provides verified capacity and voltage values. The suggestion is never applied until selected and submitted.

manual.title: Manual battery specification
manual.description: Enter the battery specification. Capacity is optional, but energy and power calculations require it.

data_description.battery_capacity: Enter the capacity printed on the battery, for example 5050 with mAh or 19.5 with Wh.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Select mAh, Wh, kWh, or MWh.
data_description.battery_voltage: Required only when capacity is entered in mAh.

tracking.title: Tracking options
tracking.description: Configure outputs and optional supporting inputs for {device_name} ({manufacturer} {model}). All Companion fields are optional and must belong to this same Home Assistant device.

data_description.precision: Number of decimal places shown for calculated values.
data_description.session_timeout: Minutes without a confirmed change before battery activity returns to idle and the estimated battery power returns to 0.
data_description.create_activity_sensor: Create a regular sensor showing charging, discharging, or idle.
data_description.create_cycle_sensor: Create a diagnostic sensor showing equivalent full discharge cycles.
data_description.create_power_sensor: Create a power sensor from confirmed battery movement and elapsed time.
data_description.companion_is_charging: Activity input. Highest-priority charging evidence from the same device.
data_description.companion_battery_state: Activity input. Charging, discharging, full, or not-charging context from the same device.
data_description.companion_charger_type: Telemetry input. Charger type is shown with battery activity and never changes accounting.
data_description.companion_battery_power: Power input. Uses measured battery power when available; otherwise the original estimate remains.
data_description.companion_battery_temperature: Telemetry input. Temperature is reported as context and never changes battery calculations.
data_description.companion_battery_health: Telemetry input. Battery health is reported as provided and never changes configured capacity.
data_description.companion_battery_cycle_count: Cycle context. Hardware cycle count is compared with, but never replaces, equivalent full cycles.
data_description.companion_remaining_charge_time: Charging context. The source value is shown when available and is never estimated by this integration.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Battery Consumption
reconfigure.description: Change the source entity or source attribute. The existing sensor identity and entity registry settings are preserved.

data_description.tracker_name: Short device name used in Battery Consumption entity IDs and displayed device names.
data_description.source: Select the entity that provides the battery percentage.
data_description.attribute: Optional attribute containing the battery percentage. Leave empty to use the entity state.

error.already_configured: This battery source and attribute are already configured.
error.name_already_configured: A tracker with this name already exists.
error.unit_required: Select a capacity unit when battery capacity is entered.
error.voltage_required: Nominal voltage is required when battery capacity is entered in mAh.
error.companion_device_mismatch: Every selected Companion App entity must belong to the same Home Assistant device as the battery-level source.

reset_totals.name: Reset totals
reset_totals.description: Reset accumulated charge, discharge, equivalent full cycles, and the current activity session for the selected Battery Consumption entity.

profile_missing.title: Battery profile is no longer available
profile_missing.description: The tracker {tracker_name} uses the profile {profile_id}, but that profile is not available. Open the integration options and select an available profile or manual capacity configuration.

companion_device_mismatch.title: Companion entities belong to another device
companion_device_mismatch.description: The tracker {tracker_name} has {count} supporting entity or entities registered to a different Home Assistant device. Open the integration options and select supporting entities from the same device as the battery-level source.

source_missing.title: Battery-level source no longer exists
source_missing.description: The battery-level source configured for {tracker_name} no longer exists in Home Assistant. Reconfigure the integration and select an available battery-level source.

source_attribute_missing.title: Configured battery attribute is missing
source_attribute_missing.description: The source for {tracker_name} is available but no longer provides the configured attribute {attribute}. Reconfigure the integration and select an available attribute or use the entity state directly.

companion_entity_missing.title: Optional Companion entity no longer exists
companion_entity_missing.description: The tracker {tracker_name} has {count} configured supporting entity or entities that no longer exist. Open the integration options and select available supporting entities or leave those optional fields empty.

user_profile_catalog_invalid.title: Custom battery profile catalog is invalid
user_profile_catalog_invalid.description: The custom profile catalog battery_consumption_device_profiles.json contains invalid data or {rejected_count} rejected entries. Correct the file and reload the integration. Valid bundled profiles remain available.
